t: Nothing you do reaches real students.
Write a message, post it, and see where it appears.
You can remove your own post and try again.
Create a topic, then file an assignment beneath it so students can find their work.
A co-teacher invitation appears as Pending,
while this sandbox adds a student as Active.
You can also regenerate the class code.
Need support? Open Practice Help for an explanation, guided steps, or this walkthrough.
Review what you tried and decide what needs more practice.
Return to any tab, explore in your own order, and reset whenever you want.
